warnings: A611 is a calibrated Level-1 apparent-partition model; no electrolyte speciation or Henry stages are active.
A721 uses an NTU-like empirical response, not rate-based film coefficients or validated packed-column transfer data.
Only explicit CarbonDioxide is stripped; bicarbonate/carbonate re-equilibration is not rigorous.
A722 reports a liquid ammonium-salt solution; no crystallization or dry product is claimed.
The dryer removes water only; product mineral stability and volatile losses require experimental verification.
Drying air is represented as a utility-only interface; air mass, humidity, and recycle are not modelled.
F601 uses a D5-equivalent aggregate siloxane marker and empirical media capacity; no competitive adsorption is claimed.
G601 uses a Magnus pure-water saturation pressure and ideal-gas humidity; mixed-gas fugacity is not solved.
Neutralized-liquid pH is metadata; electrolyte activity and buffering are not solved.
M501 pH is metadata; the empirical base dose does not solve buffering or electrolyte activity.
Trace nutrients remain disabled because no deficiency-based dosing data are available.
M721 target pH is retained as metadata; base dose is empirical because digestate titration data are unavailable.
R501 is a steady-state staged empirical model, not ADM1 or a dynamic microbial model.
Formula-free pseudo-components are balanced on mass, COD, C, N, P, and S; full H/O stoichiometry is not claimed.
VFA and population dynamics are reported as stage ledgers rather than explicit transient intermediates.
HRT, COD-OLR, and VS-OLR sizing bases differ by more than 25%; the selected sizing rule is visible and requires project reconciliation.
Activated-carbon mode retains intact H2S-equivalent mass and does not invent oxidation products.
Iron-sponge mode uses Fe2O3 + 3 H2S -> Fe2S3 + 3 H2O without hydration or mixed iron phases.
Biological mode uses complete H2S-to-elemental-sulfur stoichiometry with no kinetic or biomass-growth claim.
R602 water-wash partitions are empirical and do not solve pH-dependent Henry equilibrium.
Acid mode uses molecular salt bookkeeping and does not claim rigorous electrolyte speciation.
R711 uses a stoichiometrically bounded empirical recovery, not electrolyte activities or population-balance kinetics.
Only physical Orthophosphate is precipitable; unspeciated P-equivalent pools remain in liquor.
Target solids moisture and liquid yield are inconsistent by 38.75%; 'juice_yield_priority' determined the water split.
S601 uses specified trace-gas dissolution fractions; Henry-law and droplet-size distributions require data.
S701 uses the 'screw_press' option with a component-class allocation calibrated by cake moisture; no vendor curve is claimed.
T701 is a steady-state homogenization vessel; storage dynamics and settling are not modelled.
V501 uses empirical Level-1 gas partitioning; Henry-law and kLa calculations are not active.
Dissolved H2S/HS-/S-2 are carried by one HydrogenSulfide component; speciation is reporting metadata.
Raw-biogas moisture is a specified wet-mole fraction, not a saturation calculation.
Product washing uses an empirical mother-liquor displacement factor; crystal attrition and solubility require tests.
